title: No sqlite3 CLI on this machine: open DD's telemetry with node:sqlite
body: To look inside a project's telemetry (`.dd/local/telemetry.sqlite`: rolled, sessions, fires, touches, events, checks, fire_events, signals, inbox, meta, deliveries), open it with node:sqlite from a one-off script: `node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite'); const db=new DatabaseSync('.dd/local/telemetry.sqlite'); console.log(db.prepare('SELECT memory, via, kind, at FROM fire_events ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 20').all()); db.close()"`. The sqlite3 command-line tool is not installed on this development machine (`which sqlite3` finds nothing), and `deltadictum health` and the review UI already answer the common questions: fires by dimension, the capture funnel, the last deliveries (the deliveries table: memories, named and chars per delivery). Close the handle before deleting anything: Windows refuses to remove an open database.
not_derivable: What is installed on the development machine is recorded nowhere in the repository.

evidence.summary: SCHEMA: the eleven tables, deliveries added 2026-10-15.
sqlite3 is not on this machine's PATH (checked 2026-09-19, 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-21).
